description: This bar chart illustrates Recall@10 values for four methods: 'Ours', '-critiquing', '-scoring', and '-ranking'. The categories are displayed on the horizontal axis, labeled 'Ours', '-critiquing', '-scoring', and '-ranking', and appear to be ordered from highest to lowest Recall@10 value. The vertical axis represents the Recall@10 value, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, and tick labels at 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4. There is one bar for each method; the 'Ours' bar is orange and reaches approximately 0.35, while the bars for '-critiquing', '-scoring', and '-ranking' are blue and reach approximately 0.25, 0.12, and 0.28 respectively. The bars are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
caption_used: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. The bar chart illustrates Recall@10 values for four methods: 'Ours', '-critiquing', '-scoring', and '-ranking'. 'Ours' achieves the highest Recall@10 value, approximately 0.35, while '-scoring' exhibits the lowest performance at roughly 0.12. Notably, '-ranking' consistently outperforms '-critiquing' with a Recall@10 value of approximately 0.28 compared to '-critiquing's 0.25. The chart highlights a steady decline in performance from 'Ours' to '-scoring', with '-ranking' showing a slight recovery in Recall@10 values. The vertical axis ranges from 0.1 to 0.4, and the bars are color-coded, with 'Ours' in orange and the other methods in blue.
